title: Procedures for application of the QuantiFERON-TB Gold In-Tube system in pleural fluid
author: Raquel da Silva Corrêa
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.saseaee
materials: 7. After incubation at 37°C, harvesting of pleural fluid supernatants is facilitated by centrifuging tubes for 15 minutes at 2000 to 3000 RCF (g) at 25°C. Samples are collected using a pipette in aliquots for each tube (Nil, Antigen, Mitogen) and stored at -20°C or -80°C until the immunoenzymatic assay (ELISA) be performed. Samples can be loaded directly from centrifuged collection tube into the QFT ELISA plate. References: https://www.quantiferon.com https://www.qiagen.com/kr/resources/technologies/qft_technology-spotlightpages/

steps.title: Collect pleural fluid
steps.instruction: Perform thoracentesis to aspirate pleural fluid using a surgical syringe, following identification of the pleural effusion region via chest ultrasound, asepsis, and local anesthesia.

steps.title: Store and transport sample
steps.instruction: Store the collected pleural fluid in a polypropylene tube without additives and transport it to the laboratory in a thermal box.

steps.title: Dispense sample into QFT-GIT tubes
steps.instruction: Homogenize the pleural fluid in the polypropylene tube and pipette 1 mL of the sample into each of the three QFT-GIT tubes (Nil, Antigen-specific TB [ESAT-6, CFP-10 e TB7.7], and Mitogen).

substeps.instruction: Ensure QFT-GIT tubes are between 17 - 25°C (63 - 77°F) at the time of filling.

steps.title: Homogenize QFT-GIT tubes
steps.instruction: Carefully homogenize the QFT-GIT tubes by inverting them 10 times to ensure proper mixing of the pleural fluid with the compounds.

substeps.instruction: Avoid overly vigorous shaking to prevent gel disruption.

steps.title: Incubate samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 37°C ± 1°C for 16 - 24 hours in an incubator.

substeps.instruction: Perform incubation as soon as possible.
Ensure the incubator does not use CO2 or humidification.
